articleTitle: Disc Replacement vs. Microdiscectomy: What It Means When Your Surgeon Skips the Smaller Surgery
imageSubtext: What it means if you're going straight to disc replacement
pinTitle: Disc Replacement vs. Microdiscectomy: Why Your Surgeon Recommends the Bigger Surgery
pinDescription: Your surgeon says microdiscectomy won't work and wants disc replacement instead. The decision usually comes down to how your disc has deteriorated and whether the smaller surgery would lead to re-herniation. What to ask about your imaging, your surgeon's experience, and the recovery timeline before you decide.
